fields.label: About these settings
fields.message: These are the business facts used across the whole site: on the pages, in the footer and in the information Google reads. Keep them word for word the same as your Google Business Profile.

fields.label: Company name (legal)
fields.name: legal_name
fields.instructions: As registered. Shown in the address on the homepage contact card.

fields.label: Trading name
fields.name: trading_name
fields.instructions: The name customers know. Used for the logo text if no logo is uploaded.

fields.label: One-sentence description
fields.name: description
fields.instructions: One factual sentence: who you are, what you do, where. Shown as the paragraph in the homepage About section and used by Google. Up to 200 characters.

fields.label: Year founded
fields.name: founded_year
fields.instructions: Optional. Used by Google only.

fields.label: Business photos
fields.name: business_photos
fields.instructions: Up to three photos of the showroom for Google and AI search (not shown on the site). Landscape, at least 1200px wide, JPG or WebP, sRGB colour. Empty: no photos are given.

fields.label: Country code
fields.name: country
fields.instructions: Two letters, e.g. CY.

fields.label: Country
fields.name: country_name
fields.instructions: Shown at the end of the address.

fields.label: Google Maps link
fields.name: map_url
fields.instructions: The link to your business on Google Maps.

fields.label: Map embed query
fields.name: map_embed_query
fields.instructions: What the map on the Contact page searches for, as you would type it into Google Maps. The map loads only when a visitor asks for it. Empty: a directions link instead of the map.

fields.label: Latitude
fields.name: latitude
fields.instructions: From the Google Maps pin. Used by Google only.

fields.label: Phone numbers
fields.name: phones
fields.instructions: Shown on the homepage contact card, each one tappable to call.

sub_fields.label: Label
sub_fields.name: label
sub_fields.instructions: Optional, for your own reference, e.g. Sales.

fields.label: Email address
fields.name: email
fields.instructions: Shown on the homepage contact card.

fields.label: Contact button text
fields.name: contact_button_label
fields.instructions: The round button at the top right and the last item of the mobile menu. Up to 16 characters.

fields.label: How opening hours work
fields.message: Each row is one line in the hours list on the homepage. "Day", "Time" and "Note" are what visitors read. "Open on", "Opens" and "Closes" tell Google the same thing: keep both in step.

fields.label: Marques
fields.name: marques
fields.instructions: The names scrolling across the homepage under the video. Drag to reorder.

fields.label: Separator
fields.name: marquee_separator
fields.instructions: The mark shown between the names.

fields.label: Our Values
fields.message: The values shown by the Our Values block, on the homepage and on About. Edit them here once; every page that shows the block updates.

fields.label: Values
fields.name: values
fields.instructions: Four fit one row on a computer. Drag to reorder.

fields.label: Instagram
fields.name: instagram_url
fields.instructions: Used by the "Follow the floor" button on the homepage.

fields.label: Other profiles
fields.name: other_profiles
fields.instructions: Any other official profiles. Used by Google to connect them to your business.

fields.label: Footer line
fields.name: footer_tagline
fields.instructions: Next to the small logo at the bottom of every page.

fields.label: Copyright
fields.name: footer_copyright
fields.instructions: Bottom right of every page. {year} becomes the current year automatically.

fields.label: Credit
fields.name: footer_credit
fields.instructions: After the copyright. A link may be added as …; it opens in a new tab. Empty: hidden.

fields.label: The "page not found" page
fields.message: Shown when someone opens a link that no longer exists.

fields.label: Text
fields.name: notfound_text
fields.default_value: The page you were looking for has moved or no longer exists. The cars are still where we left them.

fields.label: About the design settings
fields.message: Colours, fonts, sizes, corners and logos for the whole site, on every page and in the page editor. Each setting starts at the value of the original design: change one, save, and check the site.

fields.label: Dark colour
fields.name: color_ink
fields.instructions: Dark backgrounds and text on light sections.

fields.label: Light colour
fields.name: color_paper
fields.instructions: Light backgrounds and text on dark sections.

fields.label: Accent colour
fields.name: color_accent
fields.instructions: Small red lines, active links, buttons on hover, focus rings.

fields.label: Card colour
fields.name: color_surface
fields.instructions: Dark cards and the space behind photos while they load.

fields.label: Heading font
fields.name: font_heading
fields.instructions: Headings, titles and large numbers.

fields.label: Body font
fields.name: font_body
fields.instructions: Paragraphs, menus, buttons and small labels.

fields.label: Heading font file
fields.name: font_heading_regular
fields.instructions: WOFF2, up to 2 MB. The regular style.

fields.label: Heading font file, italic
fields.name: font_heading_italic
fields.instructions: Optional. WOFF2.

fields.label: Body font file
fields.name: font_body_regular
fields.instructions: WOFF2, up to 2 MB. The regular style.

fields.label: Body font file, italic
fields.name: font_body_italic
fields.instructions: Optional. WOFF2.

fields.label: Font licence
fields.message: Upload only fonts your licence allows on a website. Without a file, the site uses the design's font.

fields.label: Heading size
fields.name: heading_scale
fields.instructions: Makes every heading larger or smaller. 100% is the design.

fields.label: Text size
fields.name: body_size
fields.instructions: Paragraph text. Small labels keep their size. 16px is the design.

fields.label: Corner rounding
fields.name: radius
fields.instructions: Cards, photos and panels. 0 is square. 24px is the design.

fields.label: Logo height, computer
fields.name: logo_height
fields.instructions: The logo at the top of every page. 46px is the design.

fields.label: Logo height, phone
fields.name: logo_height_mobile
fields.instructions: The same logo on screens up to 880px wide.

fields.label: Logo for light backgrounds
fields.name: logo_light
fields.instructions: Optional. A dark version of the logo, used in the light footer. Empty: the main logo is turned dark automatically. PNG or WebP with a transparent background, at least 300px wide.

fields.label: Default share image
fields.name: share_image
fields.instructions: Shown when a page is shared on social media or in messages and the page has no featured image of its own. 1200 × 630px. JPG or WebP, sRGB colour.

fields.label: For the site administrator
fields.message: Only administrators see this tab. Changing these can break links or the enquiry form.

fields.label: Contact button goes to
fields.name: page_contact
fields.instructions: The page opened by the Contact button (header, mobile menu, page not found). Empty: the button is hidden.

fields.label: Enquiry form shortcode
fields.name: enquire_form_shortcode
fields.instructions: From the form plugin. Empty: a preview form is shown that does not send.

fields.label: Allow AI crawlers
fields.name: allow_ai_crawlers
fields.instructions: GPTBot, OAI-SearchBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot and Google-Extended may read the site (robots.txt). Off: they are asked not to. Search engines are not affected.

fields.label: llms.txt
fields.name: llms_txt
fields.instructions: A plain-text summary for AI tools at /llms.txt: business facts, hours and the menu pages.

fields.label: Editors can change the design
fields.name: design_editors
fields.instructions: Shows the Design tab to Editors. Off: only administrators see it.
